description_en: Translates text in images with support for over 100 language pairs (including bridging). This product is designed specifically for e-commerce images, accurately handling complex text layouts within images and ensuring that translated content matches the image context. It helps e-commerce platforms and developers easily achieve multilingual conversion and presentation of image content. The product also returns layer information such as text position, font, and color within images, facilitating integration with image editors for secondary editing of translation results
description_zh: 图片翻译产品专为电商图片定制，支持 100 多种语向（含桥接），精确处理图片内的复杂文本布局，并确保翻译内容能够与图片内容匹配，帮助电商平台和开发者轻松实现图像内容的多语言转换与呈现。同时，产品支持返回图片中文字的位置、字体、颜色等图层信息，便于接入图片编辑器对翻译结果进行二次编辑
kebab_example: aliyun aidge image-translation-standard --image-url https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/I/41bKsNBDcwL.jpg --source-language en --target-language ko --including-product-area false --translating-brand-in-the-product false --glossary glossary_1 --use-image-editor false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImageTranslationStandard

parameters.help_en: Image URL: Must be publicly accessible
parameters.help_zh:
图片 URL：需公网可访问。
格式：png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp
像素：宽和高均不超过 4000
文件大小：原始文件 ≤ 10 MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The source language code. Required. For supported language pairs, see the supported language pair list
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，必填。支持的语向见支持语向列表
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. Required. For supported language pairs, see the supported language pair list
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，必填。支持的语向见支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the main subject of the image. Optional. Default value: false. This helps you protect information by avoiding translation of embedded information such as product names
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片主体上文字，选填，默认false。这可以帮助您保护信息，避免翻译诸如商品名称等嵌入信息
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names on the image. Optional. Default value: false. This helps you protect brand name information from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。这可以帮助您保护品牌名信息，避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The glossary ID. Optional. Create a glossary in the console and provide its ID. If the glossary ID is empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，可选。需要在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果提供的干预词表ID为空，则翻译结果将不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return layer information such as text position, font, and color. When set to true, layer information is returned for integration with image editors for secondary editing. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回文字的位置、字体、颜色等图层信息。设为 true 时返回图层信息，可用于接入图片编辑器进行二次编辑。默认值：false
parameters.name: use_image_editor
